# Aarogyatra Global Care — Full Context & Clinical Directory

## Organization Overview
Aarogyatra Global Care is a doctor-founded healthcare travel facilitator based in Gujarat, India. The organization assists international patients from countries including the United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, and the Middle East in accessing NABH and JCI accredited hospitals in India.

## Key Medical Specialties & Procedures

### 1. Cardiac Care & Cardiothoracic Surgery
- Procedures: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting (CABG), Coronary Angioplasty & Stenting, Valve Replacement (Aortic/Mitral), Pacemaker Implantation, Congenital Heart Defect Repairs.
- Inclusions: Pre-op diagnostics, surgeon & anesthesiologist fees, ICU monitoring, FDA/CE approved implants, dedicated coordinator, airport transfers, 4-week follow-up.
- Indications: Coronary artery disease, heart attack, arrhythmia, valvular heart disease, pediatric heart anomalies.

### 2. Orthopedics & Joint Replacement
- Procedures: Total Knee Replacement (TKR), Total Hip Replacement (THR), Revision Joint Replacement, Spinal Fusion & Discectomy, Arthroscopy (ACL/Meniscus/Rotator Cuff), Complex Trauma Fixation.
- Inclusions: US-FDA approved joint prostheses, post-operative physiotherapy, private room accommodation, coordinator assistance, 4-week follow-up.

### 3. Oncology & Cancer Care
- Procedures: Multidisciplinary tumor board assessment, surgical oncology, targeted chemotherapy, Intensity-Modulated Radiation Therapy (IMRT), immunotherapy, bone marrow transplantation.
- Inclusions: Comprehensive pathology & PET-CT reviews, clinical oncology administration, onco-nutrition, 4-week follow-up.

### 4. Kidney & Urology
- Procedures: Laser lithotripsy for kidney stones, TURP for benign prostatic hyperplasia, laparoscopic nephrectomy, dialysis planning, reconstructive urology.
- Inclusions: Nephrology evaluation, surgical team, medication, post-procedure recovery support.

### 5. General & Advanced Laparoscopic Surgery
- Procedures: Minimally invasive laparoscopic hernia repair, cholecystectomy (gallbladder), appendectomy, gastrointestinal surgeries.

## Patient Journey & Logistics
1. Medical Report Submission: Encrypted and confidential report review by doctor-founders within 48 hours.
2. Treatment Plan & Quote: Transparent, all-inclusive hospital quotes with 60–80% savings compared to Western private healthcare.
3. Travel Logistics: Indian e-Medical Visa facilitation, medical attendant visas, flight coordination, airport pickup in Ahmedabad/Surat/Vadodara.
4. Hospital Care: Private room, personalized dietary arrangements, dedicated bilingual coordinator present at appointments.
5. Aftercare: 4-week post-discharge WhatsApp check-ins and remote physician coordination.
